svg.aria-label: Nine sample lives under the skill model, and the spread of years to Master across four hundred people given the same training
svg.text: Nine lives under the skill model
Level against age. Each word has five steps. A dotted stretch is a level held at the edge of a word: a concept not yet grasped, or a proof not yet given.

g.text: talent S, and every concept comes easily; a grandmaster teaches her

circle.title: 15: Swordsmanship reaches Expert: a bout won before the school
18: Swordsmanship reaches Master: a bout won before the school
23: Swordsmanship reaches Grandmaster: a bout won before the school

g.text: talent C; a sergeant, then the ranks; steady for forty years

circle.title: 30: Swordsmanship reaches Expert: a fight won on the border (what was stored lands at once)
41: Swordsmanship reaches Master: a fight won on the border

path.title: 15: Swordsmanship, a breakthrough: a word from Sergeant Wynn; you see the guard at last

g.text: talent B; a master teaches him all his life; the feint read never comes

circle.title: 18: Swordsmanship reaches Expert: a tourney bout won

path.title: 17: Swordsmanship, a breakthrough: a lost bout at a tourney; you see the bind at last
18: Swordsmanship, a breakthrough: a lost bout at a tourney; you see the measure at last

g.text: talent A, proud; a master teaches him three months a year

circle.title: 34: Swordsmanship reaches Expert: a duel won

g.text: talent C; begins letters at 45, at a school

circle.title: 50: Letters and learning reaches Expert: a disputation carried
61: Letters and learning reaches Master: a disputation carried

path.title: 47: Letters and learning, a breakthrough: a word from the school; you see the source weighed at last

g.text: talent C; begins the sword at 45, with the same hours

circle.title: 55: Swordsmanship reaches Expert: a bout won

g.text: talent B; a village forge to 31, then a city and a master

circle.title: 31: Craft reaches Expert: a commission judged good (what was stored lands at once)
37: Craft reaches Master: a commission judged good

g.text: talent B; a rival a word ahead beats her for years

circle.title: 17: Swordsmanship reaches Expert: a fight won on the road
27: Swordsmanship reaches Master: a fight won on the road

path.title: 33: Swordsmanship, a breakthrough: beaten again by Sir Rauf; you see the stillness at last

g.text: talent A; a wound at 30, away twenty-two years, back at 52

circle.title: 18: Swordsmanship reaches Expert: a fight won
24: Swordsmanship reaches Master: a fight won

path.title: 24: Swordsmanship, a breakthrough: a word from the order's master; you see the tempo at last

svg.text: The same training, four hundred people
All of ordinary talent (C), a master's drill and two bouts a year from fourteen. Years until Swordsmanship reaches Master: 343 do, between 8 and 49 years; 57 never do.
years of training to reach Master
